title: Working with AI in quick cards

cards.say: A **context window** is the amount of text and information a model can consider in one request.
**Temperature** changes how varied the model's choices are. Lower values are steadier; higher values are more exploratory.
**Retrieval** gives a model relevant source material before it answers, which can improve accuracy on current or private information.
An **evaluation** is a repeatable check that measures whether an AI system does the job well enough for its users.

cards.q: Match each idea to its job
pairs: Sets how much information fits in one request
Brings relevant source material into the task
Checks quality against a repeatable standard
cards.why: These controls solve different problems: space, useful evidence, and measurable quality.

cards.q: Tap the habit that makes AI work less reliable.
sentences: Check important claims against a source.
Give the model the context it cannot know.
Assume a polished answer must be true.
Test the workflow with realistic examples.
cards.why: A fluent answer can still be wrong. Verification and realistic tests make AI work more dependable.
